summary: @servicetitan/startup 38.1.3 preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases (v1.3.13), writes it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a 727KB sibling file `math_init.js` shipped at the tarball root. `math_init.js` is heavily obfuscated (hex-numbered string-array cipher with an array-rotation decoder, single-letter identifiers, opaque numeric literal array of ~727KB) and its logic is not statically analyzable. The two files (`setup.mjs` and `math_init.js`) sit at the tarball root but are not listed in package.json `files` (`bin`, `dist`, `eslint`, `jest`, `patches`, `src`, `tsconfig`), indicating they were injected outside the declared manifest. Running `npm install @servicetitan/startup@38.1.3` fetches Bun and executes attacker-supplied obfuscated code on the installer host under a non-Node runtime, bypassing Node-based install-time inspection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
